rationale: uptime-probes: the dispatch-only surfaces and spend health probes (the schedule is disarmed in build mode, standing rule 16). One run is one firing of uptime-probes.yml. Registered so the workflow records its own run (CLAUDE.md rule 17) and the closure gate's NEVER-RUN check reads the ledger row; the artifact is emitted by scripts/lib/emit-workflow-run-artifact.mjs from the workflow's own record job.
